comments.text:
Unfortunately it's really only viable on Harmony and on weapons with forced Electric or Gas procs on heavy attacks, because slash/toxin/heat procs are too slow and will get you the curse even if the enemy dies from them.
Ultimately outside of specifically Harmony this feels like a "win more" mod and not an upgrade. You need to only be fighting enemies your heavy attacks can kill in a single hit, and no more. And the moment it fails to kill or you whiff the attack, you get punished in such a way as to make what was already less than ideal (enemies not dying, you whiffing an attack) that much worse.
